# What Is Called Thinking?

*[Martin Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) · 1954 · *Was heißt Denken?**

The lecture course of 1951-1952, the first [Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) gave after his ban on teaching was lifted, published in 1954. He repeats there that what is most thought-provoking is that we are still not thinking, and that science, by its nature, "does not think".
